model: EWAT-B / EWAFT-B / EWAT-C / EWAFT-C air-cooled inverter chillers (Microtech 4, ARES software)
applies_to: EWA(F)T-B and -C air-cooled chillers (F = free-cooling) with a Microtech 4 controller running ARES software, per D-EIGOC00207-24_05EN.
summary: Daikin Applied Europe's EWA(F)T-B/C air-cooled inverter chillers run a Microtech 4 controller that acts as a Modbus RTU slave over RS-485, either through a POL902 plug-in module or a licensed on-board software option. Every point is a 16-bit holding register: unit and circuit status, water and refrigerant temperatures and pressures, setpoints, compressor and pump states, free-cooling status and individual alarm flags.

addressing.note: The guide says each holding register address is 4xxxx plus the Address column value, so column 1 = 40001 = wire address 0. Subtract 1 from the column value for the PDU address; in a Modicon-style tool enter 40000 + column.

source.title: BAS integration guide - Modbus protocol, EWA(F)T-B-C (ARES)
source.pages: POL902 setup p. 7; software option p. 8; integration list pp. 9-21; alarm codes from p. 22

notes: Addressing: the guide says every point is a holding register addressed as 4xxxx plus the number in its Address column, i.e. Modicon references (1 = 40001). On the wire that is the column value minus 1. Registers are listed here with that wire address; the documented field keeps the guide's column value.

Values are 16-bit words; 'Gain' is the multiplier (0.1 means tenths of a unit). Temperatures and pressures are shown in metric units; the 'Measurement unit setpoint' register (column 316) switches the unit system between English and Metric.
The Read/Write column only uses R and W; W points are taken as writable (and readable) and listed as RW. Points marked 'Prio 8' are commanded at priority 8 per the guide.

Left out: every 'UNSIGNED DOUBLE' (32-bit) point (74-75 Circ 1 Compressor 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 87-88 Circ 1 Compressor 2 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 100-102 Circ 1 Compressor 3 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 113-114 Circ 2 Compressor 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 126-127 Circ 2 Compressor 2 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 139-140 Circ 2 Compressor 3 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 165-166 Circ 1 Compressor 4 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 204-205 Circ 2 Compressor 4 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 260-261 Performance - Unit Thermal Capacity (32-bit); 262-263 Performance - Unit Power Input (32-bit); 266-267 Performance - Unit Thermal Energy (32-bit); 268-268 Performance - Unit Electrical Energy (32-bit); 303-304 Evaporator Pump 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 306-307 Evaporator Pump 2 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 1900-1901 Unit - Active Energy (32-bit)). The guide does not say which word is high, and some address spans are misprinted, so they cannot be decoded safely from this document.
Left out: the alarm code/index table in section 5.1; the Warning/Problem/Fault Index and Code registers are listed, but their meanings need that table.
Free-cooling registers (columns 250-254) only apply to EWAFT (free-cooling) units.

integration.summary: Read holding registers from wire address 0: Unit Status (col 15), leaving water temperature (col 17) and capacity (col 13). Enable the unit with col 9 and send the cooling setpoint to col 35 (tenths of °C).
integration.enable: Either fit a POL902 module and set address/parity/stop bits/baud under Main menu > Commissioning > Modbus (service password), or switch on software option #1 'Modbus Slave MSTP' under Commissioning > Configuration > Software Options with its unlock password, then set the parameters under Commissioning > SW Modbus MSTP.
quirks: Addresses are Modicon-style: subtract 1 from the guide's column value.
Gains of 0.1 apply to temperatures, pressures and percentages.
setup: POL902 module defaults: address 1, no parity, 2 stop bits, 19200 baud, 5 ms response delay; port T2 passive.
Software-option defaults: 19200 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit (2StopBits = No), 100 ms delay and response timeout; address varies.
gotchas: Stop-bit defaults differ between the POL902 module (2) and the software option (1).
The software option needs an unlock password from Daikin.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
